brandbook.positioning: App ficticia de Esteban para mantener hábitos personales con una correspondencia clara entre cada hábito, su fecha y una marca realmente guardada. Una herramienta de trabajo desde la primera pantalla, sin promesas ni contenido comercial.
brandbook.voice: Español directo, tranquilo y concreto. Usar Hoy, Semana, Añadir hábito, Guardando, Guardado y Reintentar. Explicar incertidumbres sin afirmar un resultado no confirmado. Mostrar discretamente «Demo ficticia de Esteban».
brandbook.motif: Siete pulsos equivalen a los siete días de lunes a domingo. La banda, las columnas y los indicadores comparten geometría y alineación; las fechas y estados son reales. Hoy se reconoce por contorno azul y un día completo por verde confirmado, siempre con alternativa textual.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: Demo ficticia de Esteban
examples.text: Keep this attribution discreet, below the main working content rather than beside every action.

examples.title: Project basis
examples.text: The supplied plan defines the name, palette, seven-day motif and two views. The symbol and compositions express that brief.

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Organize the manual into identity, visual tools and application studies. Keep section labels left-aligned and page numbers in a consistent narrow column.

pages.title: Defining Pulso
pages.summary: Make the seven-day board the defining composition. Align date band, habit rows and weekly columns so each confirmed mark has an unmistakable habit and date.

examples.title: Hoy
examples.text: Place Añadir hábito beside the view title, followed by the seven-day band and working rows.

examples.title: Semana
examples.text: Place the same habits beneath aligned dates; summary and chart follow the board.

pages.title: Purpose & direction
pages.summary: Express the supplied project purpose without inventing a corporate mission. Describe creating habits, recording days and reviewing a week; avoid promises about personal transformation.

examples.title: Practical description
examples.text: Crea hábitos personales, marca cada día y revisa tu semana.

examples.title: Avoid outcome promises
examples.text: Do not replace the practical description with claims such as “Cambia tu vida en siete días.”

pages.title: Design values
pages.summary: Treat clarity, calm and honest state as project design criteria, not invented company values. Give every action a visible place and every uncertain result precise language.

examples.title: Clarity
examples.text: Keep “Leer”, “Aprendizaje” and its weekly goal together in one spacious habit row.

examples.title: Honesty
examples.text: Use “No se pudo confirmar el resultado” when the outcome is uncertain, not “No se guardó”.

examples.title: Calm
examples.text: Use “Guardado” without confetti, streak pressure or celebratory claims.

pages.title: Tone of voice
pages.summary: Write interface copy in direct, calm Spanish. Use sentence case, short verbs and specific next steps. Never turn errors into blame or frame missed days as failure.

examples.title: Actions
examples.text: Añadir hábito · Editar · Cancelar · Reintentar

examples.title: Recoverable error
examples.text: No se pudo cargar la semana. Reintentar.

examples.title: Field guidance
examples.text: Escribe un nombre de 1 a 60 caracteres.

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the identity with one generous symbol-and-name composition. The seven blue segments are a fixed signature, not a live display of weekly results.

examples.title: Pulso
examples.text: Place the blue symbol beside the ink-colored name on white.

examples.title: Section divider
examples.text: Keep explanatory copy below the lockup, outside its clear space.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The mark has seven rounded vertical segments sharing one baseline. Its rising and falling rhythm suggests a week without representing measured activity.

examples.title: Canonical geometry
examples.text: Keep all seven segments, their varied heights and the shared baseline exactly as supplied in the SVG.

examples.title: Name treatment
examples.text: Render “Pulso” separately in the interface family, weight 600, with natural letter spacing.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Use a horizontal symbol-and-name lockup for the application header. Start with a 32 px symbol box, a 12 px gap and a 24 px name; align their optical centers.

examples.title: Header lockup
examples.text: Pulso appears before Hoy and Semana; navigation is visually separate from the name.

examples.title: Dark application
examples.text: Keep the blue mark on a white support surface and set the separate Pulso name in white.

pages.title: Logo safe zone
pages.summary: Reserve clear space equal to one eighth of the square symbol box around the complete lockup. Keep navigation, panel edges and status text outside that zone.

examples.title: 32 px symbol
examples.text: Allow at least 4 px of exterior clear space; retain the separate 12 px symbol-to-name gap.

examples.title: 80 px symbol
examples.text: Allow at least 10 px around the lockup on a project cover or sign.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Use blue for the mark and ink for the name on white or pale blue. On blue or ink backgrounds, preserve the blue mark inside a white support surface.

examples.title: Light header
examples.text: Symbol #355CCC, Pulso #172D50, background #FFFFFF.

examples.title: Ink cover
examples.text: Background #172D50, white name and title, blue symbol supported by white.

examples.title: Reserved green
examples.text: Never recolor the logo #5A8E4C; that color belongs only to confirmed completion.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the original seven-pulse symbol alone only when Pulso is already identified nearby or in application metadata. Preserve the square canvas and fixed proportions.

examples.title: App icon
examples.text: Use the same seven-segment geometry as the header symbol, centered on a white canvas.

examples.title: Not a progress meter
examples.text: Do not change segment heights, remove days or turn segments green as records change.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline or decorate the mark. Do not merge its segments into letters, add a container as part of the geometry or rebuild the name inside the SVG.

examples.title: Avoid distortion
examples.text: A wide header must not stretch the square mark to fill the available space.

examples.title: Avoid false meaning
examples.text: Seven green segments would suggest confirmed completion; keep the signature blue.

examples.title: Avoid decoration
examples.text: No glow, gradient, shadow trail or animated equalizer treatment behind Pulso.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use one clear family throughout the interface. Keep titles, labels and instructions left-aligned; hierarchy comes from size, weight and spacing rather than multiple typefaces.

examples.title: Tu semana
examples.text: Revisa las marcas de cada hábito.

examples.title: Section treatment
examples.text: Set a single large heading above a short supporting line, with no uppercase eyebrow label.

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Arial is the specified fallback. Lexend may replace it throughout only when locally available; no Lexend files are supplied here. Do not present Arial as Lexend or mix families.

examples.title: Todavía no tienes hábitos
examples.text: Añade tu primer hábito para empezar.

examples.title: Single-family rule
examples.text: Use the selected family for Pulso, navigation, fields, chart labels and status messages.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Set body copy and fields at 16 px in the selected family. Preserve accents, punctuation and accepted habit names exactly; allow long names to wrap rather than truncating them.

examples.title: Añadir hábito
examples.text: Nombre, categoría y meta semanal.

examples.title: Long-name specimen
examples.text: Practicar respiración consciente antes de empezar el día

pages.title: Typography styles
pages.summary: Use 600 for interface titles and the Pulso name, 400 for body text and 600 for key action labels. Avoid italics, all caps and extra-heavy UI headings.

examples.title: Semana
examples.text: Consulta las marcas confirmadas de lunes a domingo.

examples.title: Weight pairing
examples.text: Set “Semana” at 32 px/600 and its supporting sentence at 16 px/400.

examples.title: Status style
examples.text: Set “Guardando” and “Guardado” at 14 px/400; distinguish their meaning through wording, not weight alone.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use the same family at 12–14 px for categories, dates and secondary guidance. Keep important validation messages at 14–16 px and next to their fields.

examples.title: Meta semanal
examples.text: Elige un número entero de 1 a 7.

examples.title: Secondary pairing
examples.text: Use Quiet Context for “Aprendizaje” beneath an ink-colored habit name.

examples.title: Date labels
examples.text: Use “Lun” visually, with the full Spanish date available in the control’s accessible name.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Use titles at 28–36 px/600, body and fields at 16 px, navigation at 14–16 px and secondary text at 12–14 px. Let spacing separate levels before adding borders.

examples.title: Hoy
examples.text: Añadir hábito

examples.title: Working order
examples.text: Pulso and navigation → view title and action → seven-day band → habit rows → row-level feedback.

examples.title: Semana extension
examples.text: Place the summary and chart after the rows, never above the main weekly controls.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use an 8/16/24/32 px spacing scale and shared left edges. At 1440 px, center a maximum 1120 px workspace; on smaller screens, reflow rows rather than hiding controls.

examples.title: Cada hábito, en su fila
examples.text: Nombre, meta y marcas permanecen juntos.

examples.title: Tablet · 768 px
examples.text: Reserve about 220 px for name and goal, followed by seven columns with 44 px controls. Expand editing across the row.

examples.title: Mobile · 390 px
examples.text: Budget about 56/60/76 px for header, title/action and band. Place seven 44 px controls with 2 px gaps below each habit.

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Keep pale blue and white dominant. Ink carries reading, blue carries action and focus, and green appears only after completion is confirmed.

examples.title: Workspace palette
examples.text: Open Sky #EFF5FB surrounds Clear Space #FFFFFF rows and the weekly band.

examples.title: Meaning before decoration
examples.text: A blue outline identifies today. A green mark identifies a confirmed completed habit/date.

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve every supplied hex value. Quiet Context is the fifth semantic palette color; Confirmed Leaf is an additional completion token, not a replacement for muted text.

examples.title: Background and surface
examples.text: Open Sky #EFF5FB · Clear Space #FFFFFF.

examples.title: Action and reading
examples.text: Steady Pulse #355CCC · Deep Focus #172D50 · Quiet Context #52627A.

examples.title: Confirmed completion
examples.text: Confirmed Leaf #5A8E4C. Pair a green indicator with an ink label and a check; avoid small white text on green.

pages.title: Using tints
pages.summary: Use the supplied pale background as the main tint treatment. Keep text and interactive boundaries at full strength; do not create pale success states or decorative gradients.

examples.title: Quiet separation
examples.text: Separate a white editor from the pale blue workspace with spacing and a restrained boundary.

examples.title: Future date
examples.text: Use a neutral disabled treatment plus “Fecha futura”; do not rely on faded opacity alone.

examples.title: Focus
examples.text: Use a visible #355CCC focus outline with separation from the control edge.

pages.title: Graphic elements
pages.summary: Repeat the seven-part rhythm through date bands and aligned columns, not decorative card grids. Keep logo pulses fixed while data indicators reflect confirmed records.

examples.title: Weekly band
examples.text: Lun · Mar · Mié · Jue · Vie · Sáb · Dom

examples.title: Daily completion
examples.text: Color a day green only when all current habits have confirmed marks for that date. With no habits, no day is complete.

examples.title: Signature motion
examples.text: After confirmation, scale the mark from 0.85 to 1 in 160 ms. Reduced motion applies the result immediately.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use a consistent simple outline icon style within shadcn controls. Pair unfamiliar actions with text, keep touch targets at least 44 px and preserve visible keyboard focus.

examples.title: Añadir hábito
examples.text: Pair a plus icon with the full action label; the icon does not replace the label.

examples.title: Completion control
examples.text: Combine a check shape, state wording and color. Accessible names identify the habit and full date.

examples.title: Row actions
examples.text: Use explicit accessible labels such as “Editar Leer” and “Eliminar Leer”, rather than two unnamed icons.

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Do not use photography in Pulso. Let real interface structure, typography and the seven-pulse motif carry the identity; avoid lifestyle imagery and stock productivity scenes.

examples.title: Empty view
examples.text: Show “Todavía no tienes hábitos” with Añadir hábito and the date band, not an illustration or photograph.

examples.title: Project presentation
examples.text: Use a privacy-safe interface composition instead of a desk, runner or meditation photo.

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the reference board from typographic and geometric fragments: pale workspace, white band, ink labels, blue focus and one confirmed green state. Keep imagery out.

examples.title: Rhythm reference
examples.text: Seven equal date columns sit beside the seven rounded segments of the Pulso symbol.

examples.title: Editorial reference
examples.text: Pair “Hoy” with a spacious row and a small “Guardado” label; show hierarchy without decorative statistics.

examples.title: Exclude
examples.text: No restaurant layouts, note-editor canvases, radial week wheels or repeated promotional cards.

examples.text: Label presentation sheets “Design study” outside the interface crop. Specimen habit names are not starter records.

pages.title: Application icons
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the compact-avatar purpose to Pulso’s app identity, not social accounts. Center the unchanged symbol on white without badges, initials or status overlays.

examples.title: Compact identity
examples.text: Use the blue seven-pulse symbol alone for small app identification; keep the name in adjacent text when space allows.

pages.title: Project identity panel
pages.summary: Design study: use a restrained identity panel on presentation material instead of a social profile. Keep it informational; add no avatar account, follow control or membership claim.

examples.title: Pulso
examples.text: Una demo ficticia de Esteban para llevar hábitos personales.

examples.title: Panel structure
examples.text: Place the lockup above one descriptive sentence. Do not add follower counts, badges or invented contact details.

pages.title: Square interface studies
pages.summary: Design study: use square presentation tiles to explain one interface state, not to create an Instagram channel. Preserve a readable title, a seven-day band and one clear message.

examples.title: Todavía no tienes hábitos
examples.text: Añade tu primer hábito para empezar.

examples.title: Composition
examples.text: Crop around the real workspace structure. Keep the empty state honest and omit sample metrics or promotional calls to follow.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: a project poster uses an oversized Pulso name, a seven-column rhythm and one factual description. Avoid outcome promises, event details and invented access links.

examples.title: Una semana, siete días
examples.text: Pulso · Demo ficticia de Esteban para llevar hábitos personales.

examples.title: Poster grid
examples.text: Align headline and description to the first column. Use blue pulses on white with generous space, not a full-page dashboard.

pages.title: T-shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: treat garments and totes as project identity mockups, not merchandise. Use one blue symbol with a separately typeset name; avoid green and decorative slogans.

examples.title: Pulso
examples.text: Demo ficticia de Esteban

examples.title: Placement
examples.text: On a white tote, center a modest lockup with ample clear space. Keep the seven segments intact at print size.

pages.title: Demo handout sleeve
pages.summary: Design study: replace takeaway packaging with a paper sleeve for project handouts. Use the seven-part motif as structure, without implying a shipped product or purchase.

examples.title: Conoce Pulso
examples.text: Hoy y Semana: dos vistas para llevar hábitos personales.

examples.title: Sleeve composition
examples.text: Use a white front, ink copy and a blue symbol. Keep folds and openings outside the logo safe zone.

pages.title: Direct-access entry
pages.summary: Design study: replace pickup wayfinding with safe access guidance inside either view. Explain that direct access may use a separate context; never imply that lost credentials transfer.

examples.title: Abrir directamente
examples.text: El acceso directo puede usar un contexto distinto al de esta ventana integrada.

examples.title: No podemos acceder a tu contexto
examples.text: Reintenta en el contexto original. Un acceso distinto no recupera por sí solo tus hábitos.

pages.title: Habit controls
pages.summary: Design study: use shadcn Dialog for creation, an inline row editor for changes and AlertDialog for deletion. Keep errors near fields and preserve the last confirmed mark while sending.

examples.title: Añadir hábito
examples.text: Nombre · Categoría · Meta semanal · Crear hábito

examples.title: Validation and save
examples.text: Accept names of 1–60 characters, one of three categories and integer goals of 1–7. Show Guardado only after confirmation.

examples.title: ¿Eliminar «Leer»?
examples.text: También se eliminarán sus registros. Cancelar · Eliminar hábito

pages.title: Save confirmation
pages.summary: Design study: replace a receipt with concise, local state feedback. Keep pending, confirmed and uncertain outcomes distinct; never let an older response erase a newer visible draft.

examples.title: Guardado
examples.text: Los cambios se han guardado.

examples.title: Cambios sin guardar
examples.text: Revisa los campos indicados antes de guardar.

examples.title: No se pudo confirmar el resultado
examples.text: Reintenta para recuperar el resultado de esta operación.

pages.title: Weekly progress strip
pages.summary: Design study: replace rewards with factual progress toward each weekly goal. Use confirmed records only, distinguish goal progress from daily completion and add no points or streak prizes.

examples.title: Tu semana, hasta hoy
examples.text: El resumen muestra únicamente marcas confirmadas.

examples.title: Progress presentation
examples.text: Place each habit’s confirmed weekly count beside its goal. In aggregate, cap each habit’s contribution at its own goal.

examples.title: Sin hábitos todavía
examples.text: Añade un hábito desde Hoy. Do not display a percentage when there is no goal total.

pages.title: Workspace sign
pages.summary: Design study: replace restaurant signage with a demo workspace identifier. Use the primary lockup and a brief descriptor, without inventing premises, opening hours or a public venue.

examples.title: Pulso
examples.text: Demo ficticia de Esteban

examples.title: Viewing distance
examples.text: Use a white panel with a blue symbol and ink name. Increase the complete lockup together; do not widen the mark.

pages.title: Two-view application
pages.summary: Design study: keep exactly / for Hoy and /semana for Semana. Both use the same private persisted habits. Preserve the shared header; show summary and shadcn/chart only in Semana.

examples.title: Hoy
examples.text: Todavía no tienes hábitos. Añadir hábito.

examples.title: Semana
examples.text: Todavía no hay marcas esta semana. Ve a Hoy para añadir un hábito.

examples.title: Navigation and dates
examples.text: Use Hoy · Pulso and Semana · Pulso as page titles. Show Monday–Sunday dates from America/Bogota; future dates stay visible but disabled.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: use the canonical seven-segment SVG for favicon and app icon artwork. Preserve the 160 × 160 canvas, blue fills and white support where needed; add no wordmark.

examples.title: Hoy · Pulso
examples.text: Semana · Pulso

examples.title: Small-size treatment
examples.text: Derive raster sizes from the same geometry. Keep all seven segments; do not substitute a P or a template icon.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: project documents use a small top-left lockup, a clear title and a restrained footer. Carry the interface’s spacing and typography into print without a dashboard background.

examples.title: Pulso · Notas de diseño
examples.text: Tablero semanal, hábitos y estados de guardado.

examples.title: Document system
examples.text: Use ink body copy on white, blue section rules and generous margins. Reserve green for a genuine confirmed-state specimen.

pages.title: Project cards
pages.summary: Design study: replace business networking details with a compact project introduction. Preserve Esteban’s supplied attribution and omit invented surnames, titles, email addresses and URLs.

examples.title: Pulso
examples.text: Demo ficticia de Esteban · Aplicación de hábitos personales.

examples.title: Front and reverse
examples.text: Front: symbol and name. Reverse: the short description, left-aligned. No fabricated contact block.

pages.title: Habit prompt card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a gift card with a non-commercial paper prompt. It is a project artifact, not a redeemable item or an extra application feature.

examples.title: ¿Qué hábito quieres añadir?
examples.text: Piensa en un nombre, una categoría y una meta de 1 a 7 días por semana.

examples.title: Prompt layout
examples.text: Place the question above three open writing lines. Omit value amounts, redemption codes and purchase language.

pages.title: Document seal
pages.summary: Design study: use the brandmark as a small identity sticker on project materials. It must not resemble certification, a privacy guarantee or a completion reward.

examples.title: Pulso
examples.text: Demo ficticia de Esteban

examples.title: Seal treatment
examples.text: Keep the blue symbol on white, with clear space around all seven segments. Do not add a green tick or an approval claim.

pages.title: Recovery guidance
pages.summary: Design study: keep recovery beside the affected task within Hoy or Semana. Offer truthful retry and access choices; do not add a support chat, new owner or false working session.

examples.title: No podemos acceder a tus hábitos
examples.text: Las cookies necesarias pueden estar bloqueadas. Reintentar · Abrir directamente

examples.title: No encontramos la sesión anterior
examples.text: Vuelve al contexto original para intentar recuperarla. No crearemos otro contexto automáticamente.

examples.title: No se pudo confirmar el resultado
examples.text: Conservamos tu edición en esta vista. Reintenta para recuperar el resultado antes de continuar.

examples.title: Colophon
examples.text: New identity: original seven-pulse symbol, supplied palette and single-family typography. The guide describes design intent, not delivered functionality.

examples.text: Use white space, an ink title and the blue symbol on white. End without a sales message, invented link or promise.
